title: On Fire, On Purpose
description: At the Tall Timbers Research Station and Land Conservancy near Tallahassee, Florida, prescribed burns are a normal part of studying fire ecology and working toward long-term land conservation. These low- to moderate-intensity fires can improve forest health by clearing dense vegetation and invasive plants. In turn, fire-tolerant native vegetation has room to grow, helping make forests more resilient to severe wildfires.
translated_description: 在佛罗里达州塔拉哈西附近的Tall Timbers研究站和土地保护区，计划烧除是研究火灾生态学和致力于长期土地保护的一项常规工作。这些低至中等强度的火灾可以通过清除茂密植被和入侵植物来改善森林健康。反过来，耐火的本地植被有了生长空间，有助于使森林对严重野火更具韧性。
